map.双引号字符串会解析变量：$name 会被替换成变量值，\\$ 才表示字面量的美元: Double-quoted strings interpolate variables: $name is replaced by the variable's value, and only \$ means a literal dollar sign. So if user-supplied text contains $, dropping it straight into double quotes can cause unintended interpolation or even information disclosure. The safer approach is to prefer single-quoted strings, or use nowdoc to avoid interpolation.

map.先去掉首尾空白；以单引号开头时判为单引号字符串，否则判为双引号字符串，存在成对外: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed first; a string starting with a single quote is treated as a single-quoted string, otherwise as a double-quoted string, and matching outer quotes are stripped. Single-quote mode directly replaces "backslash + any character" with the character itself. Double-quote mode scans character by character: on a backslash followed by another character, it escapes by the following character — n to newline, r to carriage return, t to tab, v to vertical tab, f to form feed, e to ESC, and backslash, double quote, and dollar sign to themselves; x takes the following 2 hex digits as a code point; u followed by an opening brace takes the hex digits up to the closing brace as a code point and skips past it, otherwise it takes the following 4 hex digits; when the following character is an octal digit, up to 3 consecutive octal digits are parsed base-8 as a code point; otherwise the following character itself is taken. Characters that are not escape sequences are kept as-is
